expectedItems.name: Amoxicillin
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Take Amoxicillin 500 mg three times daily after meals for 7 days.

expectedItems.name: Rest
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Rest adequately and walk gently as tolerated.

expectedItems.name: Fluid intake
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Drink adequate fluids throughout the day.

expectedItems.name: Physician review
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Review with the physician after 3 days.

expectedItems.name: Worsening breathlessness
expectedItems.sourceSentence: Contact the hospital for worsening breathlessness, persistent high fever, confusion, or blue lips.
